FACT_ID: sec11-F01 | anchor: A01
Headlights serve sight and conspicuity, high beams drop to low within one thousand feet of oncoming traffic or six hundred behind leaders, lamps burn wherever signed and from thirty minutes past sunset to thirty before sunrise, open-country highs allow car-free darkness at below-day speeds, and streetlights, fog, rain, snow, and foul weather all demand lows [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-F02 | anchor: A01
Stick shifts trade gears for brakes in slowing, clutches floor at starts, shifts, and sub-ten stops, feet never ride the pedal, smooth clutch-gas coordination takes practice, neutral coasting and held clutches stay banned outside shifts, steep descents take lower gears, and downgrade neutral or clutch coasting violates O-S Title forty-seven chapter eleven-eleven-oh-seven [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-F03 | anchor: A01
Effective rested driving seats bodies aligned at proper wheel and pedal reach with mirrors optimized, through eased seats, aimed rearviews, checked left outsides, cleared front seats, and buckled belts [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-F04 | anchor: A02
Strong grips span at least one-third of the wheel with left hands near nine to ten-thirty and right near two to four, and elbows never hang outboard where control lapses and sideswipes maim [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec11-F05 | anchor: A02
Invisible odorless tasteless carbon monoxide kills from heaters, failed exhausts, and traffic fumes with back-seat children most exposed, announces itself through drowsiness, dizziness, brightened lights, blue skin and lips, and tightening foreheads, demands roadside parking with motors off, windows open, and rest or walks plus possible artificial respiration and medics for the overcome, and yields to exhaust checks, roar alerts, never running garage motors, and vents shut in congestion but open on cold highways [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec11-F06 | anchor: A02
Interstate trips pack physical insurance and registration papers under Oklahoma law, and state law commands full road attention against trending distraction that endangers occupants, walkers, and riders alike [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec11-F07 | anchor: A03
Distraction splits visual eyes-off, manual hands-off, and cognitive mind-off, claimed over three thousand dead plus four hundred thirty-one thousand hurt nationally in twenty-fourteen, and spans eating, drinking, chatting, stereo fiddling, and texting [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-F08 | anchor: A03
Safer phoning pulls off first, never unbuckles for handsets, favors memory and voice dialing, refuses disturbance and multitasking with food, smoke, reading, or writing, keeps calls short with timely hangups, delegates to passengers, and honors personal limits, while texting bans all Oklahoma drivers since twenty-fifteen and handheld calling bans commercial and transit drivers [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-F09 | anchor: A03
Electronic-device distraction killed in ten fatal crashes in two thousand nine, and learner and intermediate holders face suspension or cancellation for non-emergency handheld use [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-F10 | anchor: A03
Never swerve for darting animals since evasive crashes outrank impacts, and cut strike odds with dawn and dusk caution, crossing-sign alertness, roadside eye-shine scans, October-to-December deer vigilance, and slowing near roadside beasts [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-F11 | anchor: A04
Long trips break against fatigue, and trunks should stage flashlights, spares with jacks, lug oil, rags, phones, water, blankets, wrenches, flares, jumpers, lug tools, send-help placards, tarps, gauges with drivers, first-aid, cordage, and candles with matches [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec11-F12 | anchor: A04
Oklahoma spreads hundreds of troopers across more than a hundred thousand road miles for millions of drivers and vehicles, while floodwater near sixty-two pounds per cubic foot slides six to twelve miles per hour, piles five hundred lateral pounds per risen foot, floats a thousand five hundred displacement pounds per foot, and buoys most vehicles including sport utilities in two feet or twenty-four inches, so stalled cars drift in any current, sub-two-foot flows sweep vehicles away, and flooded roads stay forever uncrossed [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec11-F13 | anchor: A05
Flood discipline never circles low-water barricades, heightens night and strange-road vigilance, never enters flowing water, heeds depth gauges since six inches can steal control, suspects washed roadbeds below, abandons vehicles respectfully since six fast inches topple walkers, and turns around rather than drowning [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec11-F14 | anchor: A05
Death, injury, and damage crashes demand calm stops with nine-one-one calls, lit hazards, instant help for the hurt without moving them short of life-or-death, clearing of minor blocking wrecks, exchanged vehicle, witness, and driver particulars, photographs, no-blame no-discussion silence until truthful calm officer answers, owner-unfound parked strikes answered with left names, addresses, and insurance papers, filed officer reports, and prompt insurer notice [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0063]
